proof_review: MA>=DH^(1/3)D^(-eta) implies each of R0/M and R0/A3 is >=H^(1/3)D^(-eta).
The exact capacity bound R0/M<=H^(1/3) then gives A3/M=(R0/M)/(R0/A3)<=D^eta.
Writing h=logH,r=sumlogAj,m=max(logA1,logA2), the first inequality gives 0<=h-3(r-m)<=3eta logD. This is exactly the prior nonnegative slack.
The original face portion B<=A remains allowed, including A=B. No energy lower bound or signed covariance conclusion was introduced.
scope: Necessary condition for an explicit upper-bound middle monomial to remain near its old maximum; not a sufficient condition or arithmetic energy lower bound.
